incoming.name: Wernher von Braun
incoming.excerpt: One day later, the 50th Redstone rocket was successfully launched from Johnston Atoll in the south Pacific as part of Operation Hardtack.

incoming.name: Apollo 11
incoming.excerpt: …Wake Island, or 380 km (210 nm) south of Johnston Atoll, and 24 km (15 mi) from the recovery…

outgoing.name: Calvin Coolidge
outgoing.excerpt: On July 29, 1926, President Calvin Coolidge established the Johnston Atoll as a Federal bird refuge and placed it under the control of the U.S.

outgoing.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
outgoing.excerpt: On December 29, 1934 President Franklin D. Roosevelt transferred control of Johnston Atoll to the U.S.

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: Johnston Atoll was shelled by Japan in World War II.
